items.title: Author the corrected execution plan document with all 12 verified corrections
items.context: Create docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md as the corrected version of the deleted 2026-07-02 draft. Preserve the draft's structure (18 sections: problem, claim boundary, hypotheses, arms, populations, metrics, sample size, assignment, leakage controls, scoring, analysis, artifacts, milestones, verification matrix, no-overclaim, paper integration, execution order, definition of done) and its honesty scaffolding, while incorporating the 12 verified corrections: (1) per-population sample-size parameters (seeded-trap vs live) with powered N applying to the fault-bearing stratum only, clean tasks analyzed separately for overhead; (2) composite defect rate AND repeat-defect recurrence as co-primary on the fault-bearing seeded stratum, with the section-15 allowed claim reworded to match the tested metrics; (3) full-factorial matched-pairs design (both arms on every fixture, McNemar + paired bootstrap, committed run-order seed) for the controlled seeded phase, randomized assignment retained only for the live phase; (4) risk difference as the sole primary decision criterion, relative risk descriptive-only with a predeclared zero-denominator guard, BH-FDR predeclared across the H2-H5 secondary family, per-trap breakdowns labeled estimation-with-CI; (5) name and reuse existing components: hint-mode.ts/experience-hint-surface.ts (M3 arm switch), experiments/recovery-runner (M7 harness incl. run-driver/live-engine/resumable campaign), adjudicate.mjs/checks.mjs/analyze.mjs (M4 scoring / M5 statistics primitives incl. Wilson CI, cluster bootstrap, benjaminiHochberg); (6) remove Shadow C as an allocated arm — the production control arm already computes and logs the pack losslessly (experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts); keep control-side pack logging; (7) deterministic reviewer-free primary endpoint for seeded tasks (failed validation, false-DONE from structured DONE rows + final_response_check, task-oracle mismatch, structured lane-provenance check for the reviewer-lane trap); verified reviewer findings demoted to the live phase as secondary/exploratory; (8) artifact root under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/ with Proof-or-Stop scoped as the lifecycle-readiness concept, not a directory or command-set name; (9) split fault-bearing traps into in-store traps and held-out negative-control traps (lessons NOT in the runtime memory store) with the circularity limitation disclosed in the claim boundary and paper-integration sections; (10) mechanical store isolation: per-task non-git temp roots (mkdtemp, recovery-runner precedent) because learning-store resolveLearningRoot() canonicalizes linked worktrees back to the shared main-repo .lattice/learning store; freeze the memory-pack snapshot at protocol hash for the whole powered run and forbid experiment write-back; (11) per-trap enumeration and stripping/neutralization of in-tree answer sources (e.g. verify-lattice-residue.mjs, runbook prose) with a fixture-leakage audit added to the M6 pilot exit criteria; (12) a shared-resource scheduling note in the execution order (the s5/s6 powered run completed 2026-06-29, so no gating dependency; only avoid overlapping other live multi-day campaigns and note the weekly token-budget ceiling). Entire document in English.
items.userSees: Opening docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md shows: header "Status: draft execution plan (rev 2, 2026-07-02)" with a revision-provenance paragraph naming the 2026-07-02 adversarial review; section 4 contains "There is no separately allocated shadow arm"; section 7 contains a per-population parameter table with columns "Controlled seeded (fault stratum)" and "Live" and reference N rows "~29-58" and "~294"; section 8 is titled "Study Geometry: Matched Pairs, Not Blocked Randomization"; section 12 shows the artifact root ".lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/" plus mandatory "Store isolation" and "Memory freeze" subsections; section 13 has a "Reuses" column naming hint-mode.ts / experience-hint-surface.ts / experiments/recovery-runner / analyze.mjs; section 5.1 defines "Group 2 — held-out negative-control traps"; and section 15 includes the circularity disclosure sentence.

happy.desc: File exists at the allowed path, is valid markdown with 18 numbered sections, and each of the 12 adjudicated corrections is present at its designated section (checked one by one against the correction list in CHK-001 context)

Every existing-component claim in the doc matches source: hint-mode.ts sha256 parity, experience-hint-surface.ts both-arms compute+log/render-gate, learning-store.ts resolveLearningRoot worktree canonicalization, recovery-runner mkdtemp + analyze.mjs Wilson CI/cluster bootstrap/benjaminiHochberg exports

edge.desc: Document contains zero CJK characters (grep for Unicode CJK ranges returns nothing) so the english-open-source-surface gate passes

The doc references no nonexistent paths: .proof-or-stop/ appears only inside the explicit rev-1 correction note, and every referenced repo path (scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs, experiments/recovery-runner/tasks, packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts) exists

adversarial.desc: No substantive design content beyond the 12 adjudicated corrections was introduced: diff rev-2 section-by-section against the preserved rev-1 semantics and confirm every delta maps to a numbered finding (guards against un-reviewed design entering a decision doc)
The no-overclaim rule survives intact and strengthened: sections 2/15/16 still forbid the four disallowed claims and now additionally disclose the answer-key circularity limitation
